market_summary: All assets are consolidating near key intraday levels in NEW_YORK_SESSION. Gold (XAUUSD) remains in a strong negative gamma breakdown near Session Lows but is stretched into lower ATR bands. FX pairs (EURUSD, GBPUSD) are mean-reverting around Value Area POC anchors. US100 and BTCUSD retain higher-timeframe bullish alignment above VWAP and EMA50, but lack clean volume triggers and exhibit minor CVD divergence near session highs. HOLD is recommended across the board pending clearer momentum setups.
